summary: Prices items, inserts the order, publishes order.created, returns pending.
Reads one order by id with no authentication.
Looks up an order with a string-built SQL query (injection sink).
Inserts an order row with a parameterized query.
Publishes order.created to the orders topic exchange unless PUBLISH_EVENTS is off.
Runs the Go pricing binary over stdin and stdout and returns total cents.
